candidates.study_design: ClinicalTrials.gov study type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: PHASE2; allocation: RANDOMIZED
candidates.outcome_domain: RSV prevention, immunization, protection, safety, policy, or implementation signal
candidates.key_finding: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of acute respiratory infections (ARIs), which occur in seasonal outbreaks. Among the adult population, immunocompromised individuals, particularly lung transplant recipients and recipients of allogeneic haematopoietic stem cell transplants (HSCTs), are at the highest risk of severe ARI. RSV can also cause prolonged inflammation of the airways, leading to persistent deterioration in lung function.
